records.summary: Weak indirect evidence without a direct span must not receive the supported label.
Weak indirect evidence may be recorded with the not_supported label when the source and exact preview are current.
Evidence assessed as contradicting a claim must not be used to assign the supported label.
A current artifact with verified direct entailment may support a claim under the exact validated preview.
A retracted artifact with an active retraction notice must not be attached as primary claim support.
A current artifact with verified direct support and provenance may be attached as primary evidence under the exact preview.
The current dataset card may be published only with an approved scope-matched license, verified provenance, documented restrictions, and the exact complete preview.
The completed run may update the leaderboard only after its artifact binding is verified, reviewer signoff is approved, and the exact preview is current.
A structured draft update containing an unresolved citation with no corpus match must be rejected.
A current draft may receive the structured related-work update when every cited record resolves canonically and the exact preview is current.
A rebuttal claiming improvement over all baselines must be rejected when the frozen result table contains a non-improved baseline.
A response restricted to comparisons supported by the frozen result table may be submitted after advisor approval and exact preview validation.
Participant-sensitive data must not be exported to an unregistered external contact without an active scope-matched DUA.
The approved deidentified release may be exported to its active registered collaborator under the scope-matched DUA and exact preview.
A run with frozen train-test overlap must not be published to the benchmark leaderboard.
A completed independently held-out run with a verified clean split audit may be published under the exact preview.
Adding an author requires a current draft, verified qualifying contribution, signed consent, corresponding-author approval, active policy, and exact preview.

claim_amyloid_12 may receive the supported label only when the current claim, canonical paper, verified direct assessment and sentence spans, source provenance, integrity status, active label policy, and unused preview agree.

cites_filtered_v3 may be submitted only when the current protocol cutoff, exact citation-set membership, each publication date, citation health, deduplication report, policy, and unused preview agree.

anon_sample_v2 may be published only when the current dataset and sample, completed privacy review, verified deidentification report, scope-matched DUA, license, release policy and exact unused preview agree.
run_neg_12 may be added to exp_table_55 only when registration, completed run, frozen artifact, verified statistical analysis, matching table schema, policy and exact unused preview agree.

draft_metrics_32 may be updated from run_approved_88 only when the approved run, frozen metric artifact, current checksum manifest, matching appendix schema, reviewer signoff, policy and exact unused preview agree.

MS-EMBARGO-55-R9 may be uploaded to public-preprints only when the current revision, complete author approval, expired venue embargo, active repository and publication policies, and exact unused preview all agree.

Registering the Alpha cohort DOI requires the exact approved dataset and frozen snapshot, completed final matching checksum, approved license and privacy review, current safe metadata, no existing DOI and an exact unused preview.

Publishing run_clean_3 requires the exact active benchmark, completed run, zero-overlap independent split audit, frozen verified manifest, exact reviewer signoff, active integrity policy, and unused preview.
Update CLAIM-33 only when the registration, completed seeds, final artifact and analysis, current manuscript, author approval, policy, and unused preview align.
Publish the DATA-PUB-44 link only when its registry, exact current snapshot, license, DUA, IRB scope, policy, and unused preview align.
A current unretracted artifact with verified direct spans may support claim_drug_27 under the exact current preview.
The version-4 author addition requires verified contribution, candidate consent, all current-author consents, corresponding-author approval, active policy and an exact unused preview.
